stem:
The manager of a car dealership wants to attach a rope with flags to the top of a pole and to a stake in the ground, as shown in the diagram.

Based on the diagram, what is the distance in feet from the top of the pole to the bottom of the stake?
instruction: Record your answer and fill in the bubbles on your answer document. Be sure to use the correct place value.
visual_elements: Diagram showing a right triangle with vertical side 26 ft, horizontal side 19.5 ft, and rope with flags as the hypotenuse, labeled from top of pole to stake
